name: Listbox Select
description: A custom select with native keyboard manners: typeahead, Home and End, grouped options, a spring highlight and a check that draws on the chosen row.

props.name: options
props.description: Each option takes value, label, and optional group (heading) and hint (mono text on the row).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Leave out to let the component keep its own selection.

props.name: defaultValue
props.default: "berlin" in the demo, otherwise the first option
props.description: Value on first render when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Runs when the user chooses an option by pointer or keyboard.

props.name: label
props.description: Mono label above the trigger, and the accessible name of the list.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown on the trigger while nothing is chosen.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder of the filter field when searchable is on.

props.name: size
props.description: Medium: 44px trigger and 44px rows. Small: 36px trigger and 32px rows for dense forms, 44px on touch screens.

props.name: grouped
props.description: Puts options under their group headings in first-seen order. Off, the same list reads flat.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Adds a filter field at the top of the panel. Keys go to the field while it has focus.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the trigger and closes the panel. No hover response.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where the panel opens. Auto takes the side with room and prefers below.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Opens the panel on first render without moving focus into it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the check on the chosen row. Mint on dark, a deeper green on light, where mint fails the 3:1 non-text floor.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black field and panel with white ink, or the white inverse.
